verdict.rationale: The Azure CLI is documented for scripted, non-interactive use on all major OSes and in Docker containers. Microsoft also explicitly recommends unattended REST/curl scripts for DevOps automation, and JMESPath `--query` gives machine-parseable output. Declarative IaC (Bicep, ARM, Terraform) and credential-free managed identities round out headless automation, and a community user confirms almost everything can be done via the command line. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI pipeline integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines), documented non-interactive service-principal/OIDC login for CI runners, and hands-on CI corroboration.
